title: Cold War: The Americas
description: Cuba, Chile, and the interventions that followed, 1959–1990.

events.text: Fidel Castro's revolutionaries overthrow the Batista government in Cuba
events.note: Anchor event: the starting point for the rest of the region's Cold War.

events.text: A CIA-backed force of Cuban exiles lands at the Bay of Pigs and is defeated within days
events.note: Bridges Topic 4 (Cold War) and the Cuba country study.

events.text: The United States launches the Alliance for Progress at Punta del Este
events.note: US economic response to the fear of further Cuban-style revolutions.

events.text: The Cuban Missile Crisis begins after US reconnaissance finds Soviet missile sites
events.note: The closest the Cold War came to direct US–Soviet conflict.

events.text: US forces intervene in the Dominican Republic to prevent a feared communist takeover
events.note: An early application of the Johnson administration's anti-communist intervention policy.

events.text: Salvador Allende is elected President of Chile, the first freely elected Marxist head of state in the Americas
events.note: Sets up the events of September 1973.

events.text: The Chilean armed forces overthrow Allende
events.note: Bridges Topic 4 and the Topic 6 country study.

events.text: A military junta led by Jorge Videla seizes power in Argentina, beginning the 'Dirty War'
events.note: Part of the wider pattern of US-aligned military governments in the region during the 1970s.

events.text: The Sandinistas overthrow the Somoza dictatorship in Nicaragua
events.note: Triggers US support for the Contra insurgency through the 1980s.

events.text: US forces invade Grenada following a coup against the government of Maurice Bishop
events.note: Reagan-era justification: protecting American citizens and reversing a Marxist takeover.

events.text: The United States invades Panama to remove General Manuel Noriega from power
events.note: One of the last major US interventions in the region before the Cold War's end.

events.text: The Sandinistas lose Nicaragua's presidential election to Violeta Chamorro
events.note: A negotiated end to the decade's civil war, as the Cold War itself winds down.
